criteria.requirement: Fix actual MarkdownIt.reset_rules to restore the entering active-rule sets across core, block, inline and inline2 in a finally block, on normal return, exceptions and BaseException cancellation. Nested contexts restore their own entering state, including initially disabled rules, and original exceptions propagate unchanged. Verify actual rendering after failure. Do not promise rollback of newly registered/replaced rule functions, replace parser objects or suppress consumer failures.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
